news.title: Police find stolen U-Haul crashed and emptied 20 miles from Douglasville hotel
news.summary: Thieves stole a 15-foot U-Haul and an attached Volkswagen from a Douglasville hotel parking lot during an overnight stop.

news.title: Two ejected after driver loses control on Sugarloaf Parkway curve
news.summary: Two passengers are in critical condition after being ejected during a single-vehicle rollover crash on the Sugarloaf Parkway exit ramp in Gwinnett County on Sunday morning, police said.

news.title: Gunfire erupts on Downtown Connector after suspected road rage
news.summary: A woman was shot Monday afternoon on Interstate 75/85 South near University Avenue SW in Atlanta during a suspected road rage incident.

news.title: PIT maneuver ends police chase on I-85 North in Coweta County
news.summary: A shoplifting suspect fleeing Coweta County deputies on Interstate 85 North crashed into a median wall Monday afternoon after a PIT maneuver.

news.title: Canton man gets 20 years in prison for gunpoint sexual assault
news.summary: A Canton man will spend 20 years in prison after pleading guilty to raping and kidnapping a woman at gunpoint.

news.title: Douglasville officers resign after leaving suspect on pavement
news.summary: Two Douglasville police officers resigned from the department four days after leaving a suspect face down on the asphalt outside a local hospital.

news.title: Victim, suspect identified in Gwinnett County murder
news.summary: Authorities in Gwinnett County on Monday identified a man they arrested for allegedly killing a woman, as well as the woman he’s accused of killing.

news.title: Tensions flare over security for incoming Fulton County chair: 'I want FULL DISCLOSURE'
news.summary: Fulton County commissioners revoked executive protection for incoming Chair Mo Ivory despite a viable threat confirmed by the county police chief.

news.title: ‘Out of control’: 15-year-olds charged as adults in vape killing, police say
news.summary: Two 15-year-olds are charged as adults in what police say was a deadly vape deal in Gainesville, days after Gwinnett County police say two brothers were killed during a vape sale.

news.title: Man accused of midtown Atlanta hotel murder had previous arrests involving victim, prosecutors say
news.summary: A man accused of murdering a woman inside a luxury midtown Atlanta hotel will remain behind bars as prosecutors reveal new details about his criminal history and previous encounters with the victim.

news.title: Mulberry pays $99,500 to study police department without tax increase
news.summary: A Gwinnett County city that promised voters no property tax is paying $99,500 to study whether it can start its own police department without raising taxes.

news.title: Woman in wheelchair groped in motel lobby ‘in broad daylight’; suspect hasn’t been identified
news.summary: A woman says a man groped her while she sat in her wheelchair at a metro Atlanta motel.

news.title: Police find two 15-year-olds who escaped Rome detention center
news.summary: Floyd County Police found two 15-year-olds near Swan Lake Mobile Home Park after they escaped from the Rome Youth Detention Center Saturday night.

news.title: Man gets life for killing woman over $100 left in cellphone
news.summary: A man is heading to prison for life after a jury convicted him of tracking down and fatally shooting a woman in Jonesboro over $100 taken from a lost cellphone.

news.title: 9 arrested in operation 'November Dawn' targeting online sexual predators, GBI says
news.summary: The GBI said in a release Monday the 4-day operation targeted suspects who "traveled from areas around Bartow County... with the intent to meet a child for sex."

news.title: Life plus 55 years for man convicted in 2024 DeKalb revenge shooting
news.summary: The DeKalb County District Attorney's Office announced Monday that 34-year-old Michael Pumphrey was found guilty in the case in which two other bystanders were shot.

news.title: 56-year-old man injured in gas station shooting in northwest Atlanta, police say
news.summary: No suspects have been arrested at this time.
